skill.name: api-designer
skill.description: Design REST and GraphQL APIs with OpenAPI specifications, authentication patterns, versioning guidance, validation, and generated Markdown documentation.
skill.summary: Create consistent API contracts, schemas, security models, and documentation.
skill.author: AutumnsGrove

security_audit.summary: All 146 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown syntax, example URLs and credentials, validation text, and intended local file output. The Python helper does not spawn commands, read environment variables, access certificate files, or make network requests. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or other semantic security issue was found.

content.value_statement: Inconsistent API contracts create integration errors and costly migrations. This skill guides REST, GraphQL, OpenAPI, authentication, versioning, validation, and documentation decisions.
actual_capabilities: Design resource-oriented REST endpoints, methods, status codes, pagination, filtering, and error formats.
Define GraphQL types, queries, mutations, inputs, payloads, and pagination patterns.
Create OpenAPI 3.0 structures with servers, paths, schemas, security schemes, and examples.
Recommend OAuth 2.0, JWT, API key, rate limiting, and authorization patterns.
Validate OpenAPI YAML or JSON and generate Markdown documentation with the included Python helper.
limitations: Does not implement application handlers, resolvers, databases, gateways, or deployment infrastructure.
The validator performs basic structural checks, not full OpenAPI conformance validation.
Sample generation supports only the included sample specification.
Security recommendations require review against your threat model and platform controls.

use_cases.title: Design a Service Contract
use_cases.description: Define resources, operations, schemas, errors, pagination, and authentication for a new backend service.

use_cases.title: Establish API Governance
use_cases.description: Standardize naming, versioning, deprecation, compatibility, and security rules across multiple services.

use_cases.title: Improve Developer Documentation
use_cases.description: Turn an OpenAPI specification into structured Markdown and identify missing examples or descriptions.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Basic REST API
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a REST API for [product]. List resources, endpoints, methods, request fields, response fields, status codes, and a consistent error format.
prompt_templates.scenario: Starting a new service with a clear domain.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Existing API
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this API design: [paste design]. Identify inconsistent naming, HTTP semantics, pagination, error handling, and security gaps. Propose specific corrections.

prompt_templates.title: Create an OpenAPI Contract
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 contract for [service]. Include authentication, reusable schemas, validation constraints, pagination, errors, and realistic examples. State assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Version Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a backward-compatible migration from [current API] to [target API]. Define versioning, deprecation headers, compatibility layers, rollout stages, monitoring, and client communication.

output_examples.input: Design user and order REST resources for a commerce service.
output: Resource map covering users, orders, order items, and payment references.
Endpoint table with methods, permissions, status codes, pagination, and idempotency requirements.
Consistent validation and error response guidance.

output_examples.input: Review an OpenAPI contract for authentication and consistency.
output: Findings grouped by authentication, naming, schemas, errors, and compatibility.
Recommended OAuth scopes, reusable security definitions, and response corrections.
A prioritized list of contract changes and unresolved assumptions.

output_examples.input: Plan the migration from a legacy user endpoint to version two.
output: A compatibility plan with parallel versions and an adapter period.
Deprecation milestones, client communication, telemetry, and removal criteria.
Rollback conditions and tests for old and new clients.

best_practices: Provide domain rules, actors, permissions, data sensitivity, and expected traffic before requesting a design.
Ask for explicit assumptions and review them before adopting the generated contract.
Validate generated specifications with production tooling and test representative client workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not expose credentials, private keys, production tokens, or confidential payloads in prompts.
Do not treat example URLs, identifiers, or security settings as production defaults.
Do not release breaking changes without a versioning, deprecation, migration, and monitoring plan.

faq.question: Does this skill support REST and GraphQL?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers REST resource design and GraphQL types, queries, mutations, inputs, and pagination.

faq.question: Can it create OpenAPI specifications?
faq.answer: It can design OpenAPI 3.0 content. The helper generates a sample, validates basic structure, and creates Markdown documentation.

faq.question: Does the helper make network requests?
faq.answer: No. It reads local specification files and writes requested output files.

faq.question: Will it implement my API?
faq.answer: No. It designs contracts and guidance, but does not build handlers, resolvers, storage, or deployment infrastructure.

faq.question: How complete is the included validator?
faq.answer: It checks selected required fields, paths, methods, responses, schemas, and security definitions. Use a dedicated validator for full conformance.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide domain entities, operations, actors, permissions, data sensitivity, scale expectations, compatibility constraints, and preferred output format.
